description:
We are CosmiHealth, a passionate team working on a smart project for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026. Our goal is to build a web platform that helps astronauts check, monitor, and care for their health during long space missions.

Who We Are & What We Do

We love space, coding, AI, and design. Our team is building a web app
summary:
CosmiHealth is an integrated space-medicine and astronaut resilience platform built around three specialized AI modules, interactive training scenarios, and a 3D anatomical research lab to safeguard crew health during long-duration missions.

What was developed:

Physical Health AI: Processes astronaut biometric and daily workout data, tracks exercise consistency to prevent physical deconditioning, calculates real-time health scores, and generates monthly trend charts.

Psychological Wellbeing AI: Monitors mental health, stress levels, and acute symptoms (such as shortness of breath or anxiety) to provide immediate, privacy-conscious emotional support.

Emergency AI & 5 NASA-Based Scenarios: Simulates five critical spaceflight emergencies derived from NASA protocols, guiding crews step-by-step on how to respond while raising awareness of high-risk conditions alongside an interactive 3D Human Body Explorer.

How it addresses the challenge: It combines predictive AI analytics, automated data visualization, and interactive simulations into one unified hub, helping crews maintain strict physical routines and respond accurately to physical or psychological emergencies in microgravity.

Why it is important: Even a single skipped day of exercise or a delayed reaction to stress and medical symptoms in space can severely compromise crew safety. CosmiHealth bridges that gap through continuous monitoring, preventive awareness, and actionable AI guidance.
details:
1. What is its function or how does it work?

CosmiHealth is an integrated space-medicine and astronaut resilience platform that monitors physical and mental health while training crews for emergencies through four core components:

  • Physical Health AI: Processes astronaut biometric data and daily workout logs, calculates a continuous Health Score, and generates monthly trend charts to visualize exercise consistency and the immediate physical impact of missing a workout day.
  • Psychological Wellbeing AI: Tracks mental health, stress levels, and acute symptoms (such as shortness of breath or anxiety) to provide immediate, privacy-conscious conversational support.
  • Emergency AI & 5 Interactive Scenarios: Simulates five critical spaceflight emergencies derived from NASA protocols, guiding crews step-by-step on proper response procedures alongside a preventive awareness hub.
  • 3D Human Body Explorer: Allows users to interactively explore human organs and body systems to understand how microgravity and the space environment affect each structure based on published scientific research.

2. What are its benefits?

  • Preventing Physical Deconditioning: Encourages strict adherence to daily exercise routines through real-time tracking and early alerts when performance drops.
  • Rapid Crisis Response: Minimizes human error during critical situations through hands-on scenario training and an AI emergency assistant.
  • Continuous Psychological Support: Offers a safe, accessible space to manage stress, isolation, and sudden symptoms in space.
  • Scientific Education & Awareness: Simplifies complex space-medicine concepts into interactive visual tools for students, researchers, and the public.

3. What is its intended impact?

  • For Space Missions: Enhances crew autonomy in monitoring health and making rapid medical or psychological decisions without relying entirely on real-time Earth communication, which is critical for deep-space missions (e.g., the Moon and Mars).
  • For Education & Society: Raises public awareness about preventive healthcare, space medicine challenges, and how AI can solve real-world human-factor problems.

4. What tools, programming languages, hardware, and software were used to develop it?

  • Programming Languages & Web Technologies: HTML5, CSS3, and JavaScript, combined with browser-based 3D rendering libraries (WebGL / Three.js) for the anatomy viewer and interactive data-visualization libraries for monthly charts.
  • AI & Data Sources: Data-processing and health-scoring logic powered by AI modules, built upon NASA Open Data and published spaceflight research.
  • 3D Assets: Open-source anatomical geometry (BodyParts3D / Z-Anatomy) customized for interactive web rendering.
  • Software & Platforms: Code editors (VS Code, Notepad++), GitHub & GitHub Pages for version control and live web hosting, and Canva for UI/UX graphics and visual design.
  • Hardware: Computers for coding, 3D optimization, and testing, alongside smartphones for responsive mobile testing and recording video demonstrations.

5. What is the creative aspect of the project?

  • Holistic AI Integration: Rather than acting as a simple fitness tracker or static database, CosmiHealth unifies three specialized AI systems (Physical, Psychological, and Emergency) with an interactive 3D anatomy lab in one cohesive platform.
  • Scenario-Based Learning: Transforms static NASA medical protocols into five interactive, decision-driven emergency simulations that actively test and train user readiness.
  • Visualizing Daily Accountability: Directly links daily workout consistency to dynamic health scores and monthly charts, making the consequences of skipping even a single day visually clear.

6. What factors did your team take into account?

  • Scientific Accuracy & Transparency: Grounded all content in credible NASA-linked research while clearly labeling the platform as an educational and supportive simulation rather than a diagnostic medical device.
  • Privacy & Psychological Safety: Designed the mental health AI to be privacy-conscious so astronauts feel comfortable reporting stress or acute symptoms without hesitation.
  • Usability Under Pressure: Structured a clean, intuitive UI/UX so emergency steps and health metrics are accessible within seconds during high-stress situations.
  • Performance & Accessibility: Optimized 3D anatomical models and charts to load smoothly across standard web browsers and devices without heavy hardware requirements.
